Print.description: Write a diagnostic message to the control's console and status line. Exists to prove the container -> control direction of the contract is wired, which is the half a fired event cannot demonstrate.

onMotorDoubleClick.description: The motor was double-clicked. unit is the title of the silo it drives, so one handler can tell the units apart.

Language.description: Interface language: 'en' for English or 'ar' for Arabic, which also switches the layout to right-to-left. Any other value is treated as English. Read-only from the control's side: it has no language picker, so the value only ever arrives from the container.

name.description: The scale's name, shown as the title above its silo.

required.description: The weight the batch calls for, in unit.

served.description: The weight delivered so far, in unit.

unit.description: The unit both weights are in, shown after each.

Scales.description: One entry per weighing scale, each drawn as a silo showing its name and its required and served weights. Order is the order they are laid out in.
